design.selection: largest delta whose maximum training logical retained bytes fits the cap over all supported routes; one global delta per core/precision/cap
design.rank_budget_selection: minimum grid delta whose maximum queried training rank error over all datasets and supported routes is <= threshold; not a product tolerance or universal bound
design.unreachable: unavailable within grid; no over-budget substitution; an available single-core cell may run with the unavailable companion at delta25 labelled diagnostic-only
design.held_out_budget_violation: retain, flag and report; never retune
design.comparison: common logical storage cap, not equal actual storage/capacity/RSS or optimal accuracy
